about_the_game:
Face off with up to four players in wacky mini-games that will make your mouth water!

Welcome to Bon Appétit!

Join the wildest cooking show, where up to 4 players compete in a full-course meal — from appetizer to dessert — turned into crazy mini-games.

Your host: Ms. Pat, a charismatic presenter, cracks jokes, teases, and comments on every move… just like in a live broadcast!

Between courses, surprise entremets shake things up: turn the tables, set a trap, or enjoy a twist of fate!

A universal, tasty theme

Varied mini-games

Fun and friendly competition

Ms. Pat sees and comments on everything

So… who will be the winner?

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Linux distribution released after 2016
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E8200, AMD Athlon XE BE-2300, Raspberry Pi 4
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 2500 (Ivy Bridge), AMD Radeon R5 Graphics (Kaveri)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Linux distribution released after 2020
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K, AMD Ryzen 5 1600, Raspberry Pi 5 with overclocking
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 (Pascal), AMD Radeon RX 460 (GCN 4.0)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
